Interface MKCHandledScreen.ScreenEventListener

Enclosing class:
MKCHandledScreen
public static interface MKCHandledScreen.ScreenEventListener
Listener for events happening within a MenuKit screen. All methods have default no-ops — override only what you need.

These callbacks carry MKCSlot — the library's own slot handle for a created slot, not a raw vanilla Slot. It is the right handle for own-slot event callbacks: it carries MKCSlot.address() (the slot's Address for the address world) plus getGroupId() / getLocalIndex() for display.

    • onQuickMove

      default void onQuickMove(MKCSlot sourceSlot, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack movedStack)
      A shift-click (quick move) is about to happen on a MKCSlot. Fires BEFORE vanilla routes the items — destination is unknown at this point. The movedStack is a copy of what's in the source.

      Scope: shift-click only. Other item-movement paths (drag-collect, double-click collect, hopper insertion, cursor placement, creative middle-click) do NOT fire this event — the name intentionally matches vanilla's quickMoveStack. For those paths, observe the relevant ecosystem hooks directly.

      Use for logging, analytics, or pre-transfer checks. For post-routing observation (where items ended up), a future onAfterQuickMove event would fire from quickMoveStack.
